Some people teach that God predestinates everything in advance, and therefore some are predestined to be saved and some to be damned. That just is not the case at all. God does not control or allow everything that happens in life. Some believe that nothing happens without God’s causing it or approving it (Sovereignty of God teachings). Jesus said that more will enter the broad gate to destruction than will enter the narrow gate to eternal life (Matthew 7:13-14).

The Grace and Peace of God are multiplied to us through the knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord (2 Peter 1:2). To have an abundance of Grace and Peace you need to study the Word of God, and get it in your heart (Romans 12:2), and the Love and Peace that only God can give, will fill you to the brim.
